In 1985, the Heckler Report found that Black people had higher mortality than White people, linked to acquired risk factors, social determinants of health, limited access to care, and structural barriers. The passage argues that a unifying accountability metric is missing and proposes excess deaths and years of potential life lost (YPLL) to capture the burden of early mortality. Using CDC WONDER death certificate data (1999–2020) and life expectancy from NCHS life tables, the study compares non-Hispanic Black and non-Hispanic White people under age 85, calculating excess mortality and YPLL by age, sex, cause of death, and trends over time. Over 22 years, the study estimates 658,356 excess deaths among Black females and 1,154,108 among Black males, and 34,938,070 excess YPLL among Black females and 47,005,048 among Black males. From 1999 to the early 2010s excess mortality and YPLL declined but then plateaued through 2019, followed by increases in 2020, coinciding with early COVID-19 impacts. Heart disease and cancer are identified as prominent contributors to excess mortality, and the largest YPLL differences are reported among infants. The authors conclude that excess deaths and YPLL among Black people persist, warrant national attention, and indicate the need for new strategies.

The passage explains SD card command behavior and performance-related commands, focusing on APP_CMD (CMD55) and CMD6 (switch function). APP_CMD causes the next command to be interpreted as an application-specific command (ACMD) with the same structure as regular commands; if an ACMD is undefined, it is treated as a regular command, and if illegal, it is handled as an illegal command. It also notes reserved ACMD numbers for SD proprietary applications and exceptions for ACMD41 where the APP_CMD status is not present in its response.  

It then describes CMD56 as blank in the Simplified Specification, while CMD6 is used to switch or expand SD memory card functions across access mode, command system, driver strength, and power limit groups. CMD6 supports mode 0 (check supported functions and current/power) and mode 1 (set functions), with status returned in a 512-bit block including function selection, support bits, busy status, and maximum current/power consumption. The passage further covers the High-Speed mode (25 MB/s) using CMD6, command system behavior via function groups, and details on CRC usage and command timeouts. It also includes extensive sections on speed class specifications and performance parameters for SDSC/SDHC and SDXC, including allocation units, recording units, read/write/erase timeout guidance, and Speed Class control command CMD20 for SDXC with defined functions and host requirements.

A Barrio 18 gang attack on police in San Salvador, El Salvador, resulted in one officer and two gunmen killed, with eight other officers wounded. The assault occurred while a tactical unit searched a poor neighborhood for illegal weapons. One of the gunmen was identified as a Barrio 18 operations leader in Panchimalco suspected in more than a dozen murders. Hospital director Evelyn Alvarenga said the wounded officers had superficial bullet wounds in their arms and legs; four were treated and released, and the remaining four were likely to leave the hospital within a week. El Salvador had 60 homicides per 100,000 inhabitants in 2017 and is considered among the world’s most dangerous countries.

A 26-year-old man was charged in connection with a suspicious death at Aroland First Nation in Northern Ontario. Greenstone Ontario Provincial Police were called to a residence after reports of an injured male, who was taken to hospital but later died. The OPP said the deceased was 30 years old and has charged a 26-year-old Aroland man with assault with a weapon. Nishinawbe-Aski Police Service, Greenstone OPP, and the OPP’s Northwest Region Crime Unit are investigating, and a postmortem examination will take place. The OPP and Crime Stoppers asked for public information, and Aroland First Nation is about 60 kilometres north of Longlac.

Comcast said it abandoned its bid for most of Rupert Murdoch’s Twenty-First Century Fox assets, leaving Walt Disney as the sole suitor for a $40 billion-plus deal. Comcast said it was no longer reviewing the assets and did not get the engagement needed to make a definitive offer. Disney’s negotiations with Fox are continuing, and a deal could be reached as early as this month. Comcast’s proposed acquisition would have expanded its international footprint through ownership of Sky Plc and Star network in India.

Japan’s government upgraded its assessment of business sentiment in April for the first time in four months, citing a Bank of Japan tankan survey showing corporate mood improvement. It left unchanged its overall view that the economy is recovering gradually despite remaining weaknesses. The government noted recent signs of life in exports and factory output, and that business confidence among big manufacturers rose for a second quarter to a one-and-a-half-year high. The Cabinet Office said firms’ judgment on current conditions is improving, consumer spending is continuing to recover, capital expenditure is showing signs of pickup, and exports are recovering, while warning about uncertainties abroad and fluctuations in financial markets.

The passage describes simple moving average (SMA) trading strategies and how to use SMAs as technical indicators. It defines the SMA as a continuously updated average of an asset’s closing prices over a specified period and explains that changing the SMA period affects sensitivity and trade frequency (shorter periods react faster but can create more signals; longer periods are smoother and produce fewer signals). It outlines how traders interpret SMA direction to identify uptrends, downtrends, and sideways markets, and how long-period SMAs can act as potential support or resistance levels. Backtests described in the passage suggest that short-term strategies may perform as mean-reversion systems, while longer-term strategies may perform better as trend-following systems, with the best result shown as buying when the price crosses above the 200-day moving average and holding for 200 days. The passage also discusses limitations: SMAs can be misleading in stocks with seasonal or cyclical patterns, can lag more than exponential moving averages (EMAs) because they weight all values equally, and their starting point can affect results in volatile markets. It notes that SMAs can be applied to non-price data such as trading volume and economic indicators, and that SMA signals can produce false signals in range-bound markets.

Colleges and universities are taking steps to reduce disruption around Oct. 7, following demonstrations planned for the anniversary of the Oct. 7, 2023 attacks. Columbia University has required protest and demonstration plans submitted at least two business days in advance and temporarily restricted guest access to campus through Wednesday due to increased campus activity and safety concerns. The University of Maryland has limited campus access to students and faculty with ID cards; last year, a similar attempt led to a lawsuit and settlement, and Students for Justice in Palestine plans a week of events, including a teach-in and sit-in.

Thirty-seven lawyers, including 10 incoming partners, left Cadwalader, Wickersham & Taft for Orrick, Herrington & Sutcliffe. The group’s expertise includes collateralized loan obligations and asset-backed lending. They will join a new Charlotte, North Carolina office and Orrick offices in London, Washington, D.C., and New York. Bloomberg Law reported a “lawyer exodus” from Cadwalader, counting 33 partners leaving since the beginning of the year, and noted Cadwalader’s revenue ranking declined from No. 39 in 2007 to No. 85 by the end of 2024. The article says Cadwalader may be pursuing a “shake-up path,” including adding a second managing partner and hiring more lawyers, but that the firm has still lost nearly a fifth of its partnership this year.

The passage describes an invention enabling operation of carrier aggregation and multicarrier (OFDM-based) communication, including multicarrier timing, OFDM resource structures, and uplink/downlink transmission processing. It provides terminology and extensive description of base station and wireless device architecture, scheduling and resource mapping, and protocol organization in systems such as 5G NR, including multi-connectivity with master and secondary gNBs and tight interworking between 5G RAN and LTE RAN. It discusses grouping serving cells into timing advance groups (TAGs) and mechanisms for random access in secondary TAGs, including timing advance and timer behavior for uplink time alignment. The passage also covers examples of centralized gNB deployment scenarios with CU/DU functional split options, and mentions network slicing via slice identifiers/NSSAI and resource isolation between slices. Additional sections describe use of unlicensed spectrum with LAA, including listen-before-talk (LBT) procedures and adaptive energy detection thresholds, as well as discontinuous transmission, burst definitions, and downlink control support. Finally, it outlines configurations for logical channels mapped to TTIs/numerologies (including prioritization, grant/DCI indication, and mapping constraints) and discusses bandwidth parts (BWPs), control resource sets (CORESETs), and related monitoring behavior for initial access and paging/RACH functions.

The passage reports that Yahoo’s AOL is in advanced talks to be sold to Italy’s Bending Spoons for about $1.4 billion, with sources saying no final deal has been signed yet. It describes Bending Spoons as having over 300 million monthly users and having agreed to acquire Vimeo for $1.38 billion, and it notes AOL’s 20% year-over-year traffic rise among younger users. It also discusses recent stock-related news: Tesla delivered 497,100 vehicles in Q3, beating estimates; Caterpillar is presented as an AI-related beneficiary with a 32% year-to-date rally and analyst upgrades, supported by expectations around data-center power demand; Berkshire Hathaway is buying Occidental Petroleum’s chemical business for $9.7 billion; and Wedbush highlights AI-driven M&A potential, listing Tenable, Qualys, SentinelOne, Elastic, and C3.ai as top takeover targets.

Tesla Motors, Inc. filed a Form 8-K dated April 3, 2015. The report states that on April 3, 2015, Tesla published a press release attached as Exhibit 99.1, incorporated by reference, intended to be furnished under Items 2.02 and 7.01 and not deemed filed under certain provisions of the Securities Exchange Act and not incorporated by reference in other filings except as specifically referenced. The report lists Exhibit 99.1 as the April 3, 2015 Tesla Motors press release and includes the signature of Chief Financial Officer Deepak Ahuja, dated April 3, 2015.

The passage is a presidential inaugural address thanking the predecessor and emphasizing the nation’s spiritual strength and moral principles. It cites the Bible and Micah 6:8, calls the inauguration a new dedication and spirit of unity, and urges renewed faith in the founders’ “old dream.” The speaker stresses equality of opportunity, commitment to human rights, fair laws, preserving natural beauty, and preventing persecution of the weak. The address warns against drifting or mediocrity, calls for competent and compassionate government, and describes U.S. strength abroad as depending on strength at home. It argues that America should help shape a just, peaceful, and humane world, maintain “quiet strength,” and combat poverty, ignorance, and injustice. It pledges perseverance in limiting armaments and taking a step toward eliminating nuclear weapons, aiming for a lasting peace grounded in international policies reflecting shared values.

The passage describes the DAWN-plasma randomized, open-label phase 2 trial assessing convalescent plasma plus best supportive care versus best supportive care alone in hospitalized adults with COVID-19. Convalescent plasma (4 units, ~200–250 mL each; ~884 mL median) was administered within 12 hours after randomization (2 units) and again 24–36 hours later (2 units). The study intervention lasted 48 hours, with patient follow-up for 90 days after informed consent.

Among 489 randomized patients, 483 were included in the full analysis set (320 in the plasma group, 163 in the control group). Baseline data were reported as well matched. The primary endpoint—proportion alive and free of mechanical ventilation on Day 15—was not different between groups (83.7% vs 84.1%). No statistically significant differences were reported for secondary endpoints, and safety findings were similar between arms, including serious/severe adverse events. Transfusion-related side effects were reported in 19/320 patients in the intervention group, and no TRALI cases were reported.

The passage describes intestinal obstruction as complete or partial blockage of intestinal contents beyond the small bowel due to mechanical or functional causes. Complete obstruction prevents passage of digested food particles and gas, while partial obstruction allows gas and/or small amounts of feces to pass. Intestinal obstruction is presented as a surgical emergency with high fatality rates when unattended, and the passage notes limited evidence from developing countries, particularly Tanzania, regarding burden, clinical features, causes, and outcomes. The authors report a prospective observational study in Dar es Salaam public regional referral hospitals (Amana, Mwananyamala, Temeke) recruiting adult patients undergoing surgery for suspected acute intestinal obstruction, with data collected perioperatively and followed until discharge. Among 1411 patient-days (Dec 2021–Jul 2022), male predominance (3:1) and a median age of 34 years were reported, with crude mortality of 5.3%. Adhesions were the most frequent surgical diagnosis, followed by hernia, volvulus, and abdominal tumors. Overall outcomes included 76% discharged home, 9% surgical site infection (superficial), and 5.3% deaths; outcomes did not differ significantly across hospitals.

The passage explains that averaging down is a trading or investing method where a stock owner buys additional shares after the stock price falls to lower the average purchase price and reduce how much the price must rise to reach profitability. It provides examples showing how breakeven requires a smaller percentage increase after averaging down, but clarifies that averaging down does not automatically produce breakeven—only lowers the required rise. It discusses disagreements about whether averaging down is a good technique, noting risks such as being unable to tell temporary declines from significant drops and potentially increasing losses if the stock keeps falling. The passage states that whether averaging down is suitable depends on circumstances, including whether the investor is a long-term holder who believes in the company versus a short-term trader focused on managing risk. It also gives a formula for calculating an averaging down breakeven price and describes tools that can compute average cost. Finally, it reports a backtest on SPY using RSI buy signals with a two-part scale-in and full exit on sell signals, concluding that averaging down produced a smoother equity curve, similar final capital, improved trading metrics, and reduced drawdowns, and it suggests stocks may be best for this approach due to mean reversion.

The Personalized Medicine Conference, held in South San Francisco, has addressed genomic health themes since 2008 through presentations and discussions with scientific leaders, in partnership with San Francisco State University’s Department of Biology, SF State Alumni, and the City of South San Francisco. On June 2, 2017, SF State will host Personalized Medicine 10.0, titled “Has It Changed Your Life?,” reviewing past topics and predictions and looking ahead to future personalized medicine. The conference has covered clinical advances and applications, study design, business opportunities, regulatory issues, and ethical and cultural impacts, and for 10.0 will revisit bioinformatics, data management, oncology, epigenetics, genomics of rare diseases, next-generation sequencing, the microbiome, gene therapy and genome editing, and future business-science developments. Featured keynote speaker Amylynne Santiago Volker will describe genetic sequencing that saved a person’s life and discuss challenges such as appropriate clinical use, accurate interpretation, and insurance coverage. The tenth gathering will include listed speakers from academia, industry, and organizations, and registration is open to students, researchers, industry executives, health professionals, and community members via Eventbrite or the conference website.

The passage describes therapeutic antibody development, noting that successful antibodies must both bind their targets and have suitable “developability” properties such as thermostability, low hydrophobicity, and good expression. While structure-based diffusion generative models can generate antibodies, further refinement is often needed, typically requiring many costly wet-lab optimization rounds. Bayesian optimization is presented as a way to optimize developability and binding properties efficiently with limited data, but it depends on difficult design choices, especially the surrogate model and acquisition function. The authors state that prior work has not incorporated structural information into Bayesian optimization for antibody optimization and that it is unclear which structural properties are relevant, particularly given uncertainty in antibody-antigen binding pose. The paper aims to determine how to incorporate structural information into Bayesian optimization, where it helps, whether antibody-specific structural models outperform general protein models, and whether structural information is necessary. It also proposes a sequence-only approach using a protein language model “soft constraint.” The background section defines Bayesian optimization as an uncertainty-aware framework using data to build a surrogate model and an acquisition function to select new query points until the evaluation budget is exhausted.

Cleveland Police posted an image of Steve Stephens, a homicide suspect, and urged people to call 9-1-1 if they see him; the license plate was not yet available. Joy Lane, the ex-girlfriend of Stephens, said in a message to CBS News that she had been in a relationship with him for several years and apologized for what happened, expressing prayers for the victims’ families and asking for privacy. Police said Stephens, 37, randomly shot and killed Robert Godwin Sr., 74, on the 600 block of East 93rd Street and recorded the incident on Facebook Live, including videos in which Godwin is made to say “Joy Lane” before he is shot. Officials are still investigating and searching for Stephens.

The passage describes how chronological age is used in medical risk scores and decision-making but varies between individuals, motivating “biological age” measures (“aging clocks”). It explains that biological aging clocks have been developed from molecular sources (including epigenetics, proteomics, telomere length), functional performance, and physical characteristics, with epigenetic clocks (Horvath and DNAm PhenoAge) being most studied. Age acceleration from blood-based epigenetic clocks is associated with outcomes such as cancer, dementia, and all-cause mortality, and DNAm PhenoAge shows stronger disease and biomarker associations than first-generation clocks.

The passage then presents a chest radiograph–based deep learning clock (CXR-Age) that estimates biological age from a single chest x-ray. In the Project Baseline Health Study cohort (2,097 participants), the authors report that CXR-Age has moderate correlation with chronological age, while epigenetic clocks show higher correlations. CXR-Age and DNAm PhenoAge acceleration show associations with coronary artery calcium, ASCVD risk, pulmonary function measures, and frailty/functional ability, whereas Horvath age shows fewer or no significant associations. Protein analyses identify significant associations between CXR-Age acceleration and proteins such as CDH13 and ApoD, and between DNAm PhenoAge acceleration and 13 plasma proteins, including CDH13. Manual review of extreme CXR-Age accelerations suggests more abnormal lung findings among higher CXR-Age acceleration cases. The discussion highlights that CXR-Age may capture broader aging processes relevant to cardiopulmonary function and frailty, and notes limitations including retrospective design, lack of longitudinal data, and study generalizability.

The passage describes a medRxiv preprint proposing PhenoID, a two-step NLP pipeline to extract dysmorphic physical exam findings from electronic health record text and normalize them to Human Phenotype Ontology (HPO) term IDs. It motivates the need for automated phenotype annotation because HPO term coding is labor-intensive and EHR documentation is unstructured. The study builds a standardized EHR dysmorphology documentation interface, collected de-identified free-text observations (with annotation supported by a baseline system, PhenoTagger), and produced a manually annotated corpus of 3,826 observation entries from 1,655 individuals with 935 HPO terms. Inter-annotator agreement is reported, and the authors detail annotation and span selection procedures. PhenoID uses a transformer-based sequence labeling “extractor” to detect dysmorphic mention spans while ignoring normal findings, followed by a transformer-based “normalizer” that maps each extracted mention to an HPO term ID or NA. The authors compare PhenoID to six existing normalizers and report that PhenoID achieves state-of-the-art normalization performance (F1 = 0.717) and higher performance when gold span inputs are provided (F1 = 0.820). Error analysis attributes frequent issues to ontology imperfections and descriptive or attention-misaligned spans, among other categories. The discussion notes limitations such as span extraction error and relative lack of author diversity, and concludes that ongoing NLP advances could improve performance and generalizability.

The passage describes the consolidated Aberdeen Emerging Markets Equity Income Fund, Inc. (renamed and trading on NYSE American as “AEF” as of April 30, 2018) formed from reorganizations of several prior Aberdeen funds into the Aberdeen Chile Fund. It outlines the fund’s multi-cap emerging markets equity income strategy (normally investing at least 80% of net assets, plus borrowings if used, in emerging market equity securities) aimed at current income and long-term capital appreciation. As of May 25, 2018, it lists portfolio holdings with market values and percentages, including a 5.81% position in cash and cash equivalents and other securities under 0.5% totaling 3.80%. It also notes a tender offer plus a special capital gains distribution totaling about 41% of assets as of April 27, 2018, which could further change the portfolio. The passage includes unaudited information and general investment-trading disclaimers.

SpaceX’s Falcon 9 rocket is set to launch a Hewlett Packard Enterprise supercomputer called the “Spaceborne Computer” to the International Space Station. The device is expected to perform one trillion calculations per second and is intended to process large amounts of data on board, reducing the need to send high-definition satellite imagery data back to Earth. HPE engineer Mark Fernandez said the main difference from a computer used on Earth is special software designed to detect dangerous conditions such as high radiation and make adjustments. After it is expected to boot up around September 4, Fernandez and his team will run about 2.5 hours of tests, followed by a year of testing to see if it remains operational. If successful, NASA could send more powerful computers, and similar processing capability could benefit future Mars missions by helping astronauts manage problems during communication delays.

Valeant Pharmaceuticals Intl (NYSE:VRX) shares fell 0.3% in the most recent session. New research described in PNAS (week of Dec. 11) proposes an ecological approach to drug resistance by using competition among pathogens inside a patient. The work suggests that limiting a nutrient resource can extend the effectiveness of existing drugs even when resistance is present and can prevent resistance to new drugs. In mouse experiments with malaria, adding a nutrient led to treatment failure in 40% of mice due to emergence of drug-resistant strains, while limiting the nutrient prevented resistant infections from rebounding. The researchers attribute results to competition between drug-sensitive and drug-resistant parasites and outline next steps for applying the approach to infections such as tuberculosis and malaria, including identifying resources where resistant strains have greater needs, confirming elimination of resistant strains when the resource is limited, and determining optimal timing and intervention strategies.

StatsCan data and a new academic study report that London-area unemployment rose slightly to 5.5% in September, while labour force participation declined and the number of people working or looking for work fell year over year. The study says about half of working adults have full-time permanent jobs with benefits, with the rest in part-time, temporary, contract, casual, or self-employed work with few or no benefits. The researchers link precarious employment to higher stress, poor health, and worse family life, and find young people and minorities are more likely to have unstable work. The passage also notes a low labour force participation rate among men aged 25–54 and that official unemployment figures may overlook people not actively looking for work. Across Canada unemployment was 6.2%, and Ontario employment rose while unemployment fell.

The passage describes a continuation patent application and an invention made with U.S. Department of Navy support. It provides background on LIDAR (including direct, chirped, heterodyne, and homodyne detection) and explains how chirped detection can produce ranges and 3D point clouds. It then summarizes techniques for automatic object classification from 3D point clouds, including extracting translational/rotational invariant features using surface normals, computing classification statistics (e.g., spin images, covariance matrices, and ICP for conflict resolution), and assigning an object to one of N classes or rejecting it as not belonging. The device/system implementation includes components such as a laser source, splitter, optical coupler, optical detector, and a processor to execute classification steps. The passage further outlines supporting concepts (k-d trees, point cloud representation, surface normals, feature variables, and covariance-matrix-based clustering), provides example classification methodology and experimental results, and describes general computing hardware suitable to implement the methods.

Apple Inc. filed a Form 10‑Q for the quarterly period ended April 1, 2017. The document includes condensed consolidated financial statements showing net sales of $52,896 million for the three months ended April 1, 2017 and net income of $11,029 million, along with comprehensive income, balance sheets, and cash flows for the three- and six-month periods. It also provides notes covering accounting policies, financial instruments (including derivative hedging and fair value disclosures), income taxes and unrecognized tax benefits, debt and commercial paper, shareholders’ equity (dividends and share repurchase activity), segment reporting by geographic regions, and other commitments and contingencies. The management discussion addresses forward-looking statements, sales and product performance by segment and product line, gross margin expectations, operating expenses, other income/(expense), effective tax rates, and upcoming accounting pronouncements.

The passage describes improvements in NVIDIA’s Blackwell architecture, including GeForce RTX 50 Series support for FP4 to reduce model memory use and enable running larger models locally. It outlines Blackwell RT Core enhancements for ray tracing (BVH traversal improvements, Mega Geometry for cluster-based LOD with PTLAS, opacity micromap and triangle cluster intersection, and hardware support for Linear Swept Spheres). It also covers Shader Execution Reordering (SER) 2.0, the AI Management Processor (AMP) for GPU context scheduling, and Blackwell video/display features such as 4:2:2 chroma support with a new NVENC/NVDEC, and DisplayPort 2.1b. The text further explains Blackwell power efficiency features (Max-Q innovations, advanced power gating, and accelerated frequency switching), DLSS 4 technologies (including Multi Frame Generation and transformer-based models for SR/RR/DLAA), and neural shader applications like Neural Materials, Neural Texture Compression, Neural Radiance Cache, RTX Skin, and RTX Neural Faces. It concludes with Blackwell GPU/board specifications for GB202 (RTX 5090) and mentions GB203 (RTX 5080/5070 Ti) and GB205 (RTX 5070), plus standard NVIDIA legal/accuracy disclaimers and trademarks.

A mother, Sara Zaske, said her daughter Sophia showed little interest in getting a cell phone while living in Berlin, where many children in her class did not own smartphones or even internet-connected flip phones. When the family moved to the San Francisco Bay Area, Sophia noticed she was the only student without a smartphone and asked for a phone; Zaske said they plan to give her a flip phone next year for calls and will hold off on a smartphone until high school. The passage cites studies and reports showing varying cell phone and smartphone ownership rates by country and age, including lower smartphone ownership in Europe than in the US, a younger start age in the US, and higher or earlier ownership in places like South Korea. It also notes that a wide disparity exists across cultures, and concludes that the American Academy of Pediatrics says there is no single “right” age for screens, offering specific recommendations on avoiding regular digital media for very young children and limiting screen time for children 2 to 5, along with general media-use guidance.

The passage introduces the need to understand long-term evolution of fusion reactor materials, focusing on plasma-facing components made of tungsten subjected to irradiation, helium and hydrogen implantation, and extreme conditions. It describes how irradiation damage can form helium/hydrogen-containing bubbles and how light gases can bind to dislocations, causing hardening and embrittlement and increasing tritium retention while degrading performance and longevity. Because experimental data are limited and tests are costly, computational modeling is emphasized. The passage explains that irradiation defects arise at the atomic scale and that nanoscale and micrometer-scale microstructures can be studied using DFT and MD, but DFT is too computationally demanding, motivating development of accurate classical interatomic potentials. It then presents the development of a classical EAM potential for the ternary W-H-He system to simulate radiation damage, using a loss function based on differences between modeled and DFT properties of defects and gaseous configurations, with emphasis on defect binding energies and relaxation volumes. The fitting approach uses generalized Finnis-Sinclair/EAM formulations, optimization methods, and DFT data generation and parameterization using priors such as the ZBL stopping model, including treatments for helium pair interactions, helium embedding behavior, helium-helium interactions under high pressure, and H-He interactions, along with a charge density comparison to assess qualitative accuracy.

The passage describes training a group of community residents in Alaska to conduct household energy assessments to help lower high electric bills in diesel-powered villages. Alexis Wagner fills out energy-evaluation checklists for a Juneau home while considering details such as appliance inventory, outlets, windows, and occupancy-related factors. The Renewable Energy Alaska Project (REAP) runs the “Home Energy Leader Program,” inviting residents from several Southeast communities, as an alternative to costly private audits. For about $25, assessors identify lower-cost improvements, such as replacing kitchen bulbs with LEDs and reducing energy use from appliances like coffee makers. While participants note that larger issues remain because communities rely on diesel power, small fixes are presented as a way to ease financial burdens. After assessments, the program’s final recommendations aim to cut a household electric bill by close to 10 percent, and the program runs through July 31.

National Australia Bank senior executive Andrew Hagger described widespread false document witnessing by financial advisers about superannuation beneficiaries as “sloppy and unprofessional.” The royal commission has shown wrongdoing by banks and AMP, shocking the nation and prompting apologies from those who previously questioned the need for the commission. The passage says there had been years of reporting on unethical financial advice practices, including trailing commissions, conflicted advice, insurance rorts, and fees for no service, and it cites an example in which a CBA planner allegedly put Joe Hockey’s mother-in-law’s life savings into high-risk products, wiping out much of her wealth, followed by a low initial compensation offer that was increased after a former newspaper editor became involved.

Commercial property owners in Southern Nevada have been paying trash fees charged by Republic Services without approval from municipalities’ lawmakers, according to the passage. The Las Vegas City Council plans to introduce an ordinance codifying several fees Republic has charged without approval. The ordinance and franchise agreements in Las Vegas, North Las Vegas, Henderson, and Clark County say councils (or county commissioners) must consider and approve trash fees not already covered. The passage lists examples of fees Republic charges and includes comments from industry and elected officials saying they have not recently discussed or approved such fees. Republic officials say they provide a yearly “supplemental services” list of fees to municipalities and that approval through that process governs the rates. City officials’ responses vary: North Las Vegas and Las Vegas say the ordinance itself addresses the issue, Henderson indicates the fees possibly violate the ordinance and will look into it, and Clark County says Republic does not need commissioners’ approval for certain fees.

The passage describes a Mendelian randomization study examining causal relationships among gut microbiota, plasma metabolites, and fibromyalgia (FM). It reports bidirectional MR results showing six gut taxa with causal effects on FM: family Enterobacteriaceae, Butyricicoccus, Coprococcus1, and Enterobacteriales are associated with reduced FM risk, while Eggerthella and Ruminococcaceae UCG005 are associated with increased risk. The study identifies 82 plasma metabolites associated with FM, with enrichment in pathways including caffeine metabolism, α-linolenic acid (ALA) metabolism, and GLP-1/incretin synthesis, secretion, and inactivation. Mediation MR suggests that 2,3-dihydroxypyridine and palmitoylcholine mediate effects of Enterobacteriaceae and Enterobacteriales on FM. The authors propose dietary strategies related to caffeine limitation, increased omega-3 intake, a low glycemic index diet, and reduced high-oxalate foods, and they note limitations including lack of demographic subgroup data and generalizability restricted to European populations.

Guinness announced that it will partner with international football icon Thierry Henry for its Made of Black program. Henry will come to Nigeria and work with Guinness across Africa to highlight people who demonstrate their Made of Black spirit. The passage describes Henry’s football achievements with Arsenal and awards, and includes his comments about the campaign and Nigeria’s passion for football. Guinness Nigeria Marketing Director Adenike Adebola said Henry is an inspirational ambassador for the campaign. It also notes that Guinness launched the Made of Black campaign in August 2014 on MTV Base, and that this season it will celebrate and unite football fans with Fanzone activations and live football and music experiences, while continuing to sponsor EPL broadcasts through DStv.

The passage describes a continuation patent application chain related to “MAGNET MANAGEMENT MRI COMPATIBILITY,” and provides background on conductive and sensorineural hearing loss and related hearing prostheses, including cochlear implants and other magnet-based medical devices. It summarizes embodiments of an implantable medical device that includes a magnet and a body (often elastomeric, such as silicone) with structural components configured to move away from one another when the magnet is subjected to an externally generated magnetic field, using forces that limit magnet rotation beyond an initial rotation. Other embodiments describe resisting magnet apparatus rotation relative to the body in at least one plane, an elastomeric body with a slit to enable magnet passage, and a method involving applying a magnetic field of at least 0.2 T to impart torque and limit torque transferred to a support apparatus. The detailed description focuses primarily on cochlear implants, including transcutaneous power/data transfer and implant magnet arrangements, and discusses configurations of plates, housings, magnets (including magnets in containers), and force/displacement relationships under MRI-like magnetic fields to counteract torque and prevent further rotation.

Activist hedge fund TCI Fund Management said Zodiac Aerospace shares were worth 7-10 euros each after the company posted a first-half loss. TCI is campaigning for Safran to drop its bid to buy Zodiac and previously valued it at 10 euros. TCI said an offer above 10 euros “results in value destruction,” citing a reported first-half 2017 loss and “unrealistic” forecasts of a return to mid-teen margins.

Dell Technologies CEO Michael Dell said AI computing demand is “tremendous,” though “at some point there’ll be too many” AI data centers. Dell shares rose over 3% after the company raised its expected long-term revenue and profit growth, with annual revenue growth projected at 7% to 9% (up from 3% to 4%) and diluted earnings per share expected to be 15% higher (up from 8%). Dell also said its server networking business grew 58% last year and was up 69% last quarter, and it planned to ship $20 billion worth of AI servers in fiscal 2026, double last year.

Article 2 states that quantities in the first schedule are minima only and that further purchases of those or other commodities from the Congo for import into the United Kingdom and the United States are not precluded. Article 3 requires purchases to be made at agreed prices between the Belgian Government and the UK or US, as applicable. Article 4 provides for payment in the usual manner, and Article 5 requires the UK to ensure products are not disadvantaged by customs duty compared to British colonial products. Article 6 commits the UK and US to deliver to the Congo industrial and other supplies in specified categories, consistent with wartime restrictions. Articles 7 and 8 require Belgian measures in the Congo to prohibit transactions aiding any power at war with the contracting governments, and to establish a coordinated export licensing system for economic warfare purposes. Article 9 states the agreement comes into force on signature, signed in triplicate in London in 1942. The accompanying airgram comments on clauses about possible revision before December 31, 1943, requests a list of agreed prices for use in a new tripartite agreement, discusses foreign exchange and payment for unshipped balances, and suggests adding provisions for an option on entire output, development work in the Congo, and examples related to pyrethrum production.

The Turkish government issued detention warrants for 133 former public servants, including 4 on active duty, over alleged links to the Gülen movement based on use of the messaging app ByLock. The Ankara Chief Prosecutor’s Office issued warrants for 101 Finance Ministry personnel and 32 from the Ministry of Labor and Social Security across 11 provinces, and additional detentions were reported in several other investigations. The passage also reports detentions of teachers in Aksaray and Ankara, military personnel across Turkey and the Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus, and further arrests following warrants in multiple provinces, with Turkish authorities viewing ByLock as a tool used by Gülen followers. It states that since the failed coup attempt on July 15, 2016, tens of thousands of people have been dismissed or arrested for using ByLock, and that large numbers of state employees have faced suspension or dismissal, alongside arrests and legal proceedings related to coup charges.

The passage says that although candlestick patterns have a poor predictive reputation in quantitative trading, the article presents three bullish candlestick patterns that it claims “work.” It tests the Bearish Engulfing Pattern, Three Outside Down Pattern, and Bullish Harami on the S&P 500 using SPY from 1993 to October 2021. The tests use a simple exit rule: exiting when today’s close ends the day higher than yesterday’s high, and investing 100% of equity per trade. Backtest results reported include 296 trades for Bearish Engulfing (CAGR 5%, max drawdown 16%, profit factor 2.5), 112 trades for Three Outside Down (CAGR 2.3%, max drawdown 14%, profit factor 2.6), and 306 trades for Bullish Harami (CAGR 3.1, max drawdown 25%, profit factor 1.65). The passage also notes skepticism about candlesticks due to limited quantified testing and focuses mainly on entries rather than exits.

The passage lists several “market timing” related posts, including strategies and timing models such as SuperTrend, PENTAD (Nelson Freeburg), Fabian (Richard Fabian), Coppock Curve, Yale Hirsch’s “Best 6 Months,” and Sy Harding’s Seasonal Timing Strategy. It also defines “market regime indicator” as a tool or metric used to categorize the current state of a financial market and describes market timing strategies as efforts by investors to time the market, noting many attempts fail. One post specifically tests whether market timing works for Bitcoin by varying observations compared to buy-and-hold. The site is managed by Hakan Samuelsson and Oddmund Groette and the passage ends with contact and copyright information.

The passage states that an appeal taken by appellants from Supreme Court orders (New York County) was argued and, by unanimous order, withdrawn according to a stipulation between the parties dated January 11, 2010.

The passage says NVIDIA’s Titan V benchmarks leaked from Reddit show it outperforming the Pascal-based Titan Xp and GeForce GTX 1080 Ti in Fire Strike and several game tests at 1440p. It mentions the Titan V’s base clock of 1200MHz boostable to 1455MHz without overclocking, attributes performance to Volta architecture and HBM2 memory with 652.8 GB/s bandwidth, and notes its focus on running AI systems. The passage estimates the card costs around $3,000 and suggests more affordable Volta GPUs may follow in 2018.

Microsoft Corporation filed a Form 8-K on September 22, 2016. On September 20, 2016, its Board of Directors amended Section 1.14 of the company’s bylaws (proxy access bylaw) to clarify how groups of funds count toward the 3% ownership threshold, change treatment of loaned shares recallable within five business days, clarify certain indemnification provisions, and reduce from 25% to 15% the voting support needed to re-nominate a proxy access candidate. The report also states that the 2016 Annual Shareholders Meeting was announced for November 30, 2016, with shareholders of record as of September 30, 2016 entitled to vote. Exhibit 3.2 (Bylaws of Microsoft Corporation) was filed with the report.

Sunderland manager David Moyes urged relegation-threatened players to create more scoring chances for striker Jermain Defoe after his return to the England side, saying Sunderland need Defoe’s goals and help from others. Moyes warned the team to “stand up and be counted” in their final games or face ejection from the Premier League, noting Sunderland have won once in their last 11 league games and are bottom of the table, seven points from safety with 10 games remaining. Four remaining matches are against teams in the current bottom six. Sunderland play Watford, then Leicester City, and host Manchester United in a run of three games over eight days.

The passage discusses RSI, ADX, and IBS as technical indicators for short-term trading and notes that no “Holy Grail” strategy guarantees consistent profits. It explains how RSI measures gains and losses over a period (oscillating between 0 and 100, with overbought above 70 and oversold below 30, and divergence signals for buy/sell), how ADX measures trend strength without indicating direction (non-directional, based on highs and lows, with backtests suggesting a 5–10 day period and a strong-trend threshold around 30–40), and how IBS measures the closing price’s position relative to the high and low (mean-reversion, oscillating from 0 to 1, with low bullish and high bearish). It reports backtest results for simple IBS, RSI, and ADX strategies and for combined strategies using RSI+IBS+ADX concepts, including performance metrics such as average gain per trade, CAGR, time invested, and risk-adjusted return, and states the combined strategy can show profits in specific years.

An Erie public school, closed several years ago as a cost-saving measure, has reopened as the corporate headquarters and 9th branch of Erie Federal Credit Union after an 18-month transformation. Officials cut the ribbon, held an open house, and officially opened the facility for business, offering services including face-to-face teller transactions, new account opening, loans, wealth management, safe deposit boxes, and a drive-through with an ATM and night depository, along with a community room. The project used local designers and contractors and incorporated school and local history, according to CEO Brian Waugaman. Board chairman Dan Nawrocki said the results reflected years of planning, and Mayor Joe Sinnott said the project returns the property to the tax rolls. The credit union stated the 42,000-square-foot building is large enough for future growth.

Beluga whales Qila and Aurora died at the Vancouver Aquarium in November 2016, but researchers say their DNA samples are enough to sequence the complete beluga genome. Researchers believe neither bacteria nor viruses caused the deaths, and instead the whales were overcome by an unidentified toxin. Qila spent nearly three decades at the aquarium. The study, published in Genes, says the mapped genome will provide a baseline and “many tools” to study beluga health in a rapidly changing environment and to aid in conservation measures for recovery, management, and protection.

Citadel Securities LLC hired Anthony Cronin of Societe Generale to head European Treasuries trading, effective Monday, expanding its market-making across Europe, later Asia hours, and the Middle East. The firm also hired Michele How for fixed-income sales in January and, since starting direct Treasuries market-making in 2016, has nearly tripled counterparties to over 450 and almost quadrupled average daily volume. Citadel has about 100 U.S. Treasuries clients in 17 countries and expects that number to double this year, with an initial focus on Hong Kong, mainland China, and Japan. In 2017, Treasuries traded through the firm totaled $6 trillion, up from $5 trillion in 2016, with the rise largely due to off-the-run expansion. It is working toward becoming a Federal Reserve primary dealer after it starts dealing in all required securities, and it plans to introduce missing products such as Treasury Inflation Protected Securities and strips this year.

The passage argues that although Marine Le Pen is not expected to win the French presidential election, recent events could boost her chances. It cites scandal involving François Fillon, riots in France’s suburbs following an alleged police rape of a young man, and a secret report suggesting more widespread violence than officially disclosed. The passage notes that arrests have been made and that some reports suggest violence may decrease when school resumes, while also warning it could escalate. It concludes that tensions over immigration and Le Pen’s tough-on-crime and anti-immigrant platform may persuade some voters, even though her victory is still considered unlikely.

The passage describes the Chaikin Oscillator, developed by Marc Chaikin in the 1980s, which measures accumulation/distribution momentum and oscillates around zero. It explains a four-step calculation (money flow multiplier, money flow volume, ADL update, then the difference between a short and long EMA of ADL) and states that signals can come from bullish/bearish divergences and crossings above or below the zero line. The article reports quantified tests on several trading strategies, including oscillator zero-line and oscillator/RSI-based rules, and concludes that the oscillator did not show significant predictive value in the strategies tested. An optimized S&P 500 test based on oscillator average crossings produced a CAGR of 2.4% over the last twenty years, and other strategy variants reported modest or similar results with stated trade counts, profit factors, and maximum drawdowns. The passage also notes the oscillator’s potential use for gauging buying pressure (positive values) and selling pressure (negative values).

The speakers discuss frustration during the playoffs, especially in the Rangers and Florida series, but say they have refocused and are hoping for a strong effort tonight. They note they have had scoring chances but have not scored enough, citing missed shots off the crossbar and the need to execute and finish. Andy Greene says it feels good to return to a routine on the road, get rest without long flights, and maintain focus on the game. They also review their play, mentioning turnovers and the difficulty of creating opportunities in a tight series. They describe the opponents’ style as hard-forechecking, honest, and challenging in the offensive zone, with penalty kill pressure they must counter through better execution, passing, and possibly taking more shots. They conclude with plans for practice and warmups, feeling upbeat and ready for tonight’s game.

Dwyane Wade, Gabrielle Union, and their 10-year-old son Zion visited the Phillip and Patricia Frost Museum of Science in Downtown Miami on Wednesday afternoon. They wore matching all-denim and enjoyed activities including the “Asteroid: Mission Extreme” planetarium show, viewing fish, touching stingrays, wearing UV-sensitive Frost Science sunglasses, and eating tacos from Food@Science. The passage also notes Wade’s approach to responding to Twitter trolls.

A University of Kansas researcher says drought coverage about residents conserving water is likely more complex. Brock Ternes analyzed data on 864 Kansas residents and found well ownership is significantly correlated with increased watering during droughts, and that conservation varies by well type. He surveyed 48% private well owners and 52% municipal water users, and said higher awareness in Kansas can coincide with using more water because well owners know how to draw from aquifers to sustain crops. He argues groundwater stewardship depends on selective timing of extractions and plans to present findings at the American Sociological Association’s 2017 annual meeting.

The passage describes an autonomous vehicle management system (also called a controller system) and related infrastructure aimed at improving the functional safety of AI-based autonomous driving and other autonomous vehicle operations. It uses sensor data to generate and continuously update an internal map representing the vehicle’s state and its environment, then uses goals and safety considerations to generate a safe plan of action and control vehicle systems to execute that plan. The system may use AI models such as convolutional neural networks for object identification and reinforcement learning for selecting actions, and it can evaluate “what-if” scenarios by simulating possible future interactions using the internal map. The passage also discusses dynamically controlling sensor behavior to adjust what sensor data is captured or communicated, as well as techniques for improving AI model safety via model confidence scoring and for reinforcement learning via a safety indicator (SSI) with interruptible commands. It further outlines subsystems such as sensors interface, localization, perception, planning, controls, and an information subsystem, along with example processing flows and internal map data structures (including layered 3D representations and graph-based storage).

Leon Cooperman says the market is in the late stage of a bull market that Warren Buffett warned about, with excessive valuations and signs of exuberance. He links the current rally to mood and to high valuations of artificial intelligence companies, noting the S&P 500 is up nearly 40% since April lows and has returned to all-time highs. Cooperman also points to the “Buffett Indicator,” which is above prior peaks and beyond a level Buffett said was “playing with fire.” He says stocks are less risky than bonds at these levels because elevated inflation erodes bonds’ real returns.

Several major U.S. school districts approved union teacher contract raises but later faced budget shortfalls and had to borrow money or renegotiate. Philadelphia sought permission to borrow up to $1.5 billion after a budget impasse delayed state funding for contract and operating costs. Fairfax County and Baltimore County renegotiated contracts after lack of funding, while Chicago closed a $734 million deficit after approving a four-year union contract and refinancing rather than taking a short-term loan. The passage also notes that public school debt has grown over time and that Philadelphia and Chicago had debts exceeding revenues in 2023.

The passage describes a patent application for methods and apparatus related to ACK/NACK feedback in wireless networks with multiple transmission reception points (TRPs), including multi-TRP transmissions. It introduces configurations in which a base station sends user equipment (UE) information about PDCCH monitoring occasions per TRP, whether ACK/NACK feedback across TRPs is allowed, rules for ACK/NACK bundling, and a DAI definition indicating whether DAIs are independent per TRP or joint across TRPs. The UE may then receive these configurations, determine an ACK/NACK codebook size, and transmit either joint ACK/NACK feedback on PUCCH or multiple ACK/NACK feedback independently per TRP. It also outlines general wireless system components, including base station/UE structures, frame/channel concepts, and describes examples involving joint PUCCH versus multiple individual PUCCHs for multi-TRP scenarios.

Eight-year-old Zion tested his newly assembled bicycle with his partner, Trenton Police Officer John McGinley. Big Brothers Big Sisters of Mercer County provided new, unassembled bicycles to seven children awaiting big brothers or sisters. BBBS Director Kim Cody said the event pairs children with role models for teamwork, mentoring, and fun and helps build bridges between children and law enforcement. After pizza, the children were partnered with local law enforcement officers and FBI agents. Others involved included Sallah Khan of Capital K-9 Association and actor/producer Joseph Halsey. Each team will build a second bicycle to donate to another child, funded by a grant from the I am Trenton Community Foundation.

The passage describes a C++ program, C-BerryTrans, for computing Berry curvature (Ω) and the resulting anomalous Hall conductivity (AHC) and anomalous Nernst conductivity (ANC) from WIEN2k outputs. It calculates Ω using a Kubo-like formula with eigenvalues and momentum-matrix elements extracted from WIEN2k, then integrates Ω over the full Brillouin zone, weighting AHC by the Fermi–Dirac distribution and ANC by an entropy-related kernel to capture thermoelectric response. The code parallelizes Ω calculations over k-points (OpenMP) and stores band-resolved Ω in a binary file for efficient post-processing over ranges of temperature and chemical potential. It includes modules for generating k-lists, managing k-point batches to limit RAM usage, performing post-processing to compute AHC/ANC, and visualizing weighted Ω distributions. The workflow requires SOC-enabled WIEN2k ground-state files, input parameters for k-mesh and integration windows, and supports plotting via berryTrans plot.py. It also outlines the theoretical background for AHC and ANC formulas and the role of spin–orbit coupling in producing non-vanishing transverse responses.

Tippecanoe Middle School in Tippecanoe City released honor student names for the second grading period of the 2017–18 school year. The passage discusses recent market-moving events and their impact on stocks and bonds. It describes mixed economic data: GDP came in stronger than expected but was clouded by tariff-related distortions, and nonfarm payrolls added fewer jobs than expected with large downward revisions. The Federal Reserve meeting included two dissenting votes, while Powell emphasized patience and data dependency amid uncertainty from tariff and immigration-related labor force changes. The passage also notes strong Q2 earnings so far for most reported companies and upward earnings revisions, but says market price action turned decisively risk-off with a “bearish engulfing” pattern, weakening volume and internals, and most sectors down. The passage is an issue of VentureWire dated November 16, 2000, featuring venture capital and technology news. The passage describes how CompareCards evaluates credit card offers and highlights that credit card promotions change often. It notes that banks may offer long 0% Intro APR periods and that consumers can benefit depending on their repayment habits. It then lists several featured cards with details such as 0% Intro APR lengths, cash-back or points earning rates, welcome bonuses, and other terms (e.g., balance transfer fees, redemption methods, and annual fees). Swiss Economic Affairs Minister Johann Schneider-Ammann said his ministry will consider requests from the arms industry to soften Switzerland’s weapons export rules. The industry is seeking longer export licences and a lifting of the current ban on exporting to countries involved in internal armed conflict, arguing that tight licensing has left it at a disadvantage versus European competitors and that jobs are at risk. The Security Policy Commission of the Senate said it recently heard from the three ministries involved and that political leaders were prepared to initiate an amendment to the regulations. Schneider-Ammann said the departments will examine whether action is needed and that his department will submit a proposal to the Federal Council to amend the War Material Ordinance, drawing criticism from the Group for a Switzerland Without an Army. SRF reported a likely chance of further rule softening and suggested new foreign minister Ignazio Cassis could be more arms-friendly than his predecessor.

World stocks rose on Monday after last week’s biggest weekly losses of 2017 were driven by fears over a U.S.-North Korea nuclear standoff. U.S. share index futures suggested a higher open, European shares rebounded, and Asia-Pacific gains outside Japan were led by Australia, Hong Kong, and South Korea. The VIX fell from nine-month highs, and the dollar rose off four-month lows versus the yen. Japan’s shares declined to three-month lows despite robust growth data, with concerns about the yen’s recent surge; analysts attributed yen weakness to easing geopolitical tensions. Bond yields rose, driven in part by interpretations of improving economic conditions, while Chinese activity data had limited market impact and weaker data pressured oil prices.

The passage describes computational electromagnetics problems where antennas interact with large surrounding structures, such as implantable antennas in biological tissue, reflector antennas with compact feeds, and radome-enclosed arrays. Hybrid methods are discussed as effective for multiscale problems, including a prior approach combining method of moments (MoM) and T-matrix that models the large body with spherical-wave expansion and the antenna’s fine structure with surface-current MoM, but can be less effective for electrically large, irregular environments. The authors propose a new MoM–generalized scattering matrix (GSM) hybrid framework that inverts roles: the electrically large environment is discretized and solved with MoM, while the antenna is represented by its GSM. The framework aims to reduce MoM unknowns by encapsulating antenna geometry in a compact GSM, and to leverage advances in GSM theory such as Wigner translation/rotation, array synthesis from single-element GSMs, and modular reuse of precomputed antenna data. It can also extend to variants including GSM–physical optics (GSM-PO) for large reflectors with higher-order antenna–reflector interactions, and GSM + T-matrix when the surrounding structure supports efficient spherical-wave expansion. The passage then introduces a MoM and GSM hybrid formula for a penetrable medium partitioned into interior and exterior regions, defining fields, equivalent currents using PMCHWT integral equations with RWG basis functions, and expressing antenna fields via vector spherical-wave expansions. It derives relationships between scattered-field expansion coefficients and incident expansion coefficients, culminating in mapping between antenna excitations and responses using the antenna’s GSM.

The passage describes defensive strategies against the Single/Double offense, which uses double and down screens to free a shooter. It warns that failure to defend both screens can result in an open shot and notes that NBA teams prefer “show and recover” since teams do not like to switch; showing off screen actions forces shooters wide and recovery returns defenders to pass-denial and post-posting positions. It outlines three phases for defending: dictating the shooter’s direction, defending the double screen (including show, weakside show, and recover), and defending the single screen option (show and recover), with matchups such as pressuring the wing ballhandler, denying reversals, and packing weakside defenders. It further explains “All Out SOS” disruption by trapping the shooter on the wing, forcing offensive players into improvised routes and using team fundamentals, including aggressive sideline forcing and potential inversion to keep “Big” inside. Two phases of wing trap execution are provided for disrupting the double screen option and the single screen option, specifying sequential switches, “contact” or trapping actions, and detailed rotational matchups, with cautions that closeouts and rotations must occur as the ball leaves the passer’s hands.

Pop singer Helgi Bjornsson appeared on Icelandic national television as a reporter challenged him about the premise of his 1980s hit “I Do Like the Rain.” Reykjavik has had unusually gray and wet weather, with meteorologists comparing May and June records back to 1914. High pressure over western Europe is said to have shifted the jet stream, pushing clouds and rain over Iceland while Britain and southern Scandinavia have a heat wave. Reykjavik saw sunshine for 70 total hours in June and had daily rain in May; forecasts have triggered excitement and then disappointment as clear skies were revised to clouds. Businesses and tourism have felt the impact, though some visitors adjust by dressing for the weather. A historical reference notes that in June 1914, Reykjavik received “biblical rainfall” during a hot spell elsewhere in Europe.

UBS said it will proceed with dividend increases and its share buyback program despite Swiss regulators urging higher capital buffers. CEO Sergio Ermotti stated that UBS’s shareholder return strategy is on track and that regulators have allowed flexibility to build capital without limiting payouts. The company’s stance follows increased scrutiny after its Credit Suisse takeover, with integration progressing and systems consolidation in Switzerland expected by early 2026; most operational and client transfers outside Switzerland are already finalized. UBS outlined a USD 2 billion share repurchase program from mid-2025 to 2027, alongside continued annual shareholder guidance. Analysts view the plan as signaling financial strength, though some warn it could be challenging to balance regulatory requirements with investor expectations if market conditions worsen.

The passage discusses indemnity claims related to the American bark *Cape Horn Pigeon*, including a claim of $45,000 profit allegedly from five whales lost due to an interruption of the voyage. It states that vouchers are required to justify certain items, and that the Imperial ministry of marine considers $2,500 sufficient indemnification for Captain Scullen and his crew’s real losses from temporary detention. It references an allegation that authorities at Vladivostok left the master and crew without lodging or food, and notes that Navy authorities testified Captain Scullun himself declined offered lodging and food. The passage includes telegram and note excerpts describing the vessel’s seizure by Russian naval officers in September 1892 and the crew being landed without food or shelter, requests for investigation and assistance, certifications by embassy officials dated February 17, 1900, and a reply stating the bark has been liberated and the inquiry into the circumstances is ongoing.

The passage is largely from Apple Inc.’s 2019 Form 10-K and includes details on securities registered with the SEC, market information for Apple’s common stock, share repurchase activity, and incorporated proxy statement information. It outlines Apple’s business (products, services, markets, distribution, competition), provides extensive risk-factor discussion covering areas such as global economic conditions, competition, supply and pricing risks, legal proceedings, regulatory and privacy/security risks, and other operational risks.
